en:
Fictional student councils usually have
a huge amount of authority.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

Some open host clubs, some have crazy powers,
some cook, some always say "good day to you"...

Well, our student council members are all 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimates<CLT=cltNORMAL>, so we can definitely compete.

We might even surpass those fictional
student councils!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi told me the long and colorful
history of student councils in anime...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
